LanguageData.IC_PodUnavailable: The pod is unavailable. Cancel the pending order or eject its occupant before starting again.
LanguageData.IC_PodInvalidPlan: The saved transformation plan is missing or invalid.
LanguageData.IC_PodTransferFailed: Could not transfer the pawn into the pod. The operation has stopped.
LanguageData.IC_PodOccupantLost: The occupant is dead or unavailable. Eject the contents manually.
LanguageData.IC_PodUnknownError: The transformation result is uncertain. No automatic retry will occur.
LanguageData.IC_PodMissingReport: Transformation returned no report. The pawn is retained; completion is not confirmed.
LanguageData.IC_PodEjectFailed: No safe placement was found. The occupant remains in the pod; retry extraction manually.
LanguageData.IC_PodLoadUnsafe: This operation has no saved resolved plan or was interrupted during application. Eject manually; inspect the pawn before starting a new operation. No rollback is guaranteed.
LanguageData.IC_PodPauseDesc: Pause or resume the current operation. Power is still required; the fixed plan, progress and consumed blood are retained.
LanguageData.IC_PodResetDesc: Clear the stopped order in an empty pod. This does not undo any changes to a pawn or refund blood.
LanguageData.IC_PodStatePaused: State: paused (manual pause or no power)
LanguageData.IC_PodStateError: State: error — manual action required; no automatic retry
